children: Paramount Gold Nevada Corp. reported a fiscal 2026 net loss of $(15.56M), wider than the $(9.05M) loss in fiscal 2025, with diluted loss per share of $(0.19) versus $(0.13) a year earlier. The company held $9.93M in cash at June 30, 2026, which management said is expected to fund operations into roughly March 2027 and noted substantial doubt about the company’s ability to continue as a going concern.
Net income: $(15.56M) net loss for FY 2026, compared with $(9.05M) net loss in FY 2025 (loss widened ~72% YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(0.19) for FY 2026, versus $(0.13) for FY 2025.
Cash position / runway: Cash $9.93M at June 30, 2026; expected to fund operations through ~Mar 2027 (management notes substantial doubt about going concern).
Permitting milestones: Received a BLM Record of Decision for Grassy Mountain and a state draft consolidated permit package, advancing toward final permits.
Technical studies: Completed a 2026 Sleeper Initial Assessment and updated the Grassy Feasibility Study under SK-1300 to refine mine planning and cost estimates.
Operational focus: Continued permitting, site maintenance and reclamation at Sleeper while prioritizing Grassy Mountain permitting and long‑lead procurement.
Liquidity-backed activity: Management said available cash supports near‑term permitting and discretionary project work (including drilling and power line long‑lead procurement) into fiscal 2027.
